messages:
Sofia G: Heads-up — Kestrel Health asked for a combined preflight + live lab for their Dedicated migration next week. They want a 90-minute enablement + a 2-hour hands-on lab. Preferred time: 10:00 AM PT. Renewal is in ~6 weeks, so this is high-priority to reduce risk. Need agenda, volunteers, and a short prework checklist. Any blockers?

Hank L (SE): I can lead the runtime deep-dive and KV-cache warmup demo. Available 10am PT Tue/Wed. I'll bring the migration checklist and example perf numbers.

Maya R (Onboard): I’ll facilitate the hands-on lab. Can run breakout rooms and manage lab accounts. We should require a tiny prework set so we don't waste the live time.

Jordan T (CSM): Kestrel confirmed Wed 10am PT on their side. They specifically requested an SME Q&A at the end and want a short cost-impact comparison for post-migration billing (renewal risk = medium-high). Can we add a 10–15m cost slide?

Elliot P (Ops): I’ll spin up a temporary staging dedicated pool and generate the event link. calendar-bot: please create a draft invite with recording enabled.

calendar-bot: Draft event created — https://calendar.redwood/evt/KSTL-2026 — recording ON, tentative attendees kestrel-eng@kestrel.co

Sofia G: Agenda draft (also posted in Notion: https://redwood.notion.so/kestrel-preflight). Compact agenda below so we can iterate quickly:
```
0:00–0:10 — Intros & objectives (Jordan)
0:10–0:40 — Dedicated runtime architecture + migration strategy (Hank)
0:40–0:55 — Cost/throughput post-migration snapshot (Hank/Jordan)
0:55–1:25 — Preflight checklist review & customer prework validation (Sofia)
1:25–1:30 — Break
1:30–3:30 — Hands-on lab (Maya facil) — breakout rooms by workload (ingest, embeddings, long-context)
3:30–3:45 — SME Q&A + next steps (all)
```

Hank L (SE): Suggested prework — ask customer to run our quick preflight and attach output. Command for them to run: ```bash
redwood-cli preflight --customer kestrel --checks minimal --output kestrel_preflight.json
``` If they attach kestrel_preflight.json we can triage ahead of time.

Maya R (Onboard): I'll collect requested attendee roles (eng lead, infra eng, security contact). Also planning lab accounts — need confirm who owns API keys for the lab.

Jordan T (CSM): I’ll own feedback capture and the 3-question post-session survey (technical clarity, lab usefulness, renewal confidence). I’ll tag the account as 'watch' on renewal until we get post-session exec summary.

Sofia G: Volunteers today: Hank (deep-dive), Maya (hands-on facil), Jordan (feedback & renewal note), Elliot (infra/event). @channel please react :white_check_mark: if you can commit to Wed 10am PT. We still need one extra SE for Q&A — any volunteers?

Hank L (SE): :white_check_mark: I’ll be there and can prep a short runbook to hand to the customer.

Elliot P (Ops): :white_check_mark: Event updated — Kestrel preflight & hands-on lab — Wed 10:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/evt/KSTL-2026 — invites sent to kestrel-eng@kestrel.co

Maya R (Onboard): :white_check_mark: I’ll pull the breakout room plan and send a prep checklist to the customer (1 pager).

Sofia G: Great — next steps: Hank to post runbook snippets, Maya to send prep checklist to customer by EOD tomorrow, Jordan to prepare survey and cost slide. I’ll finalize agenda in Notion and update event. If anyone else wants to hop in for Q&A, please reply here. Thanks!
